why: Each of the four verifier checks only tests what its expect line requires. Check 1 passes if the greeting for the name prints "in upper case". Comparing it to the upper-cased normal output is just what "the greeting" means. Check 2 compares the head output with the base output exactly, which is what "unchanged" requires. Check 3 asks that docs/index.md mention --shout and explain it, which is a fair reading of "documents". Check 4 requires "the PR is merged and the fetched published page lists --shout", which is what "after merge... lists --shout" requires. Its FAIL rule for an unmerged PR only reports the line as not yet shown and adds nothing stricter. The stricter items are all under "Advisory (not pass/fail conditions)": npm test, the flag placed after the name, exact outputs, the exit code and pages.yml. None of them appears in a PASS or FAIL condition.
